examples.en: Daniel is a black sheep in his family.
examples.zh: 丹尼爾是家中不受認同的一員。

examples.en: Daniel is regarded as a black sheep in his family.
examples.zh: 丹尼爾被視為家中令人蒙羞的一員。

meaning.en: Sometimes the person has genuinely behaved badly. In other situations, the label may simply show that the group unfairly disapproves of someone who is different.
meaning.zh: 指家族、團隊或其他群體中，被其他成員視為名聲不佳、經常惹麻煩、令人難堪或不獲接納的人。
naturalZh: 指家族、團隊或其他群體中，被其他成員視為名聲不佳、經常惹麻煩、令人難堪或不獲接納的人。

register.summaryEn: In careful communication, reporting frames such as is regarded as, is seen as or is unfairly treated as make it clear whose judgement is being described.
register.summaryZh: 這個慣用語通常帶有負面和批判意味。 直接稱某人為 a black sheep，可能會顯得相當尖銳。
register.formalEn: Use the idiom only in the contexts described in the source.
register.formalZh: 在較審慎的表達中，可以使用 is regarded as、is seen as 或 is unfairly treated as，清楚說明這是某個家庭或群體對當事人的評價，而不一定是說話者本人的判斷。

fixedVariable.fixedEn: Keep the fixed words and word order shown in the source expression.
fixedVariable.fixedZh: 保留原檔目標表達中的固定字詞及字序。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Change only the verb form, possessive, tense or surrounding grammar permitted by the source patterns.
fixedVariable.variableZh: 只按照原檔句式改變動詞形式、所有格、時態或前後文法。

forms.form: Person + be + a black sheep + in/within + group.
forms.example: Daniel is a black sheep in his family.

specificForms.formula: Person + be + a black sheep + in/within + group.
specificForms.descriptionEn: Core Grammar Bank. Formula: Person + be + a black sheep + in/within + group.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 核心句式庫。 句式：Person + be + a black sheep + in/within + group。

examples.en: Daniel is a black sheep in his family.
examples.zh: 丹尼爾是家中不受認同的一員。

examples.en: Daniel is regarded as a black sheep in his family.
examples.zh: 丹尼爾被視為家中令人蒙羞的一員。

examples.en: Daniel became a black sheep in the club after he was caught cheating.
examples.zh: 丹尼爾被揭發作弊後，成為俱樂部中的害群之馬。

examples.en: His dishonest decision made him a black sheep in the organisation.
examples.zh: 他不誠實的決定令他成為機構中的害群之馬。

benefits.en: Concise version: His relatives regard him as a black sheep.
benefits.zh: 這個慣用語可以把「某人被整個家族或群體視為令人蒙羞的一員」濃縮成一個較短的表達。

benefits.titleEn: It describes social position, not only behaviour
benefits.titleZh: 不只描述行為，也描述群體地位
benefits.en: The expression tells us both that a person is disapproved of and that the person stands apart from the rest of the group.
benefits.zh: 這個表達不只說明某人曾有不當行為，還會指出對方在群體中受到排斥或不被接納。

benefits.titleEn: It can report an unfair judgement
benefits.titleZh: 可以表達不公平的群體評價
benefits.en: She is unfairly treated as a black sheep simply because she refused to follow the family tradition.
benefits.zh: 配合 unfairly treated as，可以指出某人沒有真正做錯事，卻因不符合群體期望而受到排斥。

benefits.titleEn: It is useful in stories and personal accounts
benefits.titleZh: 適合用於故事及個人經歷
benefits.en: The expression can help explain family conflict, group pressure, damaged trust or a person’s feeling of exclusion.
benefits.zh: 這個表達可以用來說明家庭衝突、群體壓力、信任受損或某人感到被排斥的經歷。

benefits.titleEn: It improves understanding of authentic English
benefits.en: Learners may encounter the expression in conversations, films, interviews, news features and personal writing. An idiom is not automatically better than a plain expression. Use a black sheep only when the idea of group disapproval or exclusion is important. Model Examples Model 1: Misconduct Aaron has repeatedly cheated his relatives, so the whole family is ashamed of him. Model 2: Unfair rejection Lily has done nothing wrong, but her relatives reject her because she refuses to join the family business.
benefits.zh: 學生可能會在日常對話、電影、訪問、新聞專題及個人文章中遇到這個表達。 重要提醒： Model Examples 示範例子失當行為亞倫多次欺騙親人，因此全家都以他為恥。 亞倫多次欺騙親人，因此被視為家中令人蒙羞的一員。 不公平排斥莉莉沒有做錯事，但親人因她拒絕加入家族生意而排斥她。 莉莉只因拒絕加入家族生意，便被家人不公平地當成異類。

examples.en: Aaron is regarded as a black sheep in his family because he has repeatedly cheated his relatives.
examples.zh: 亞倫多次欺騙親人，因此被視為家中令人蒙羞的一員。

examples.en: Lily is unfairly treated as a black sheep in her family because she refuses to join the family business.
examples.zh: 莉莉只因拒絕加入家族生意，便被家人不公平地當成異類。

origin.statusZh: 逐漸形成；確切演變路徑不明

history.en: A disapproving figurative use of black sheep is documented as early as 1640. Oxford connects the later established expression with the proverb “There is a black sheep in every flock,” which was in use by the late eighteenth century.
history.zh: 早至1640年的文獻，已出現帶有貶義的 black sheep 比喻用法。 Oxford 把後來較固定的表達與 「每個羊群裡都有一隻黑羊」這句諺語連繫起來； 這句諺語在十八世紀末已有人使用。

history.en: The unusual sheep gradually became a metaphor for a person whom a family or group regarded as disreputable or embarrassing. In modern English, the label may describe genuine misconduct, but it can also reveal unfair group pressure against a person who is simply different.
history.zh: 這隻與其他羊不同的羊，逐漸成為一個比喻，指家族或群體中被視為名聲不佳或令人難堪的人。 現代英語中的這個標籤既可以指真正的失當行為，也可以反映群體只因某人與眾不同而施加的不公平壓力。

origin.memoryEn: One unusual sheep stands out in the flock; one disapproved member stands out in the group.
origin.memoryZh: 一隻與眾不同的羊在羊群中格外顯眼；一名不獲認同的成員也會在群體中被挑出來。

rules.titleZh: 當這個慣用語指一個人時，必須保留冠詞 a
rules.en: Incorrect: He is black sheep in the family.
rules.zh: 當這個慣用語指一個人時，必須保留冠詞 a。

rules.titleEn: Do not change sheep to sheeps
rules.en: Sheep has the same singular and plural form. However, the target taught in this exercise is the fixed singular phrase a black sheep.
rules.zh: Sheep 的單數和複數形式相同。 不過，本練習教授的是固定單數短語 a black sheep。

rules.titleEn: Use it for a person within a group
rules.en: a family; a team; a club; a class; a workplace; an organisation; another recognisable social group.
rules.zh: 這個表達通常指某個家族、團隊、俱樂部、班別、工作場所或機構中的一名成員。

rules.en: Being quiet, choosing an unusual career, dressing differently or holding a different opinion does not automatically make someone a black sheep.
rules.zh: 沉默寡言、選擇不常見的職業、衣着與別不同或持有不同意見，並不會自動令一個人成為 a black sheep。

rules.en: Unfair judgement: His relatives unfairly treat him as a black sheep simply because he chose a different way of life.
rules.zh: 使用這個慣用語時，要分辨當事人是否確實有失當行為，還是只因與眾不同而受到不公平排斥。

rules.en: The second and third sentences make the source of the judgement clearer.
rules.zh: 使用 regards、sees、labels 或 treats 等動詞，可以更清楚指出是誰作出這個評價。

rules.titleZh: 第一句只是在描述羊的顏色，並不是本課教授的比喻意思
rules.en: Idiomatic: The dishonest member is regarded as a black sheep in the club.
rules.zh: 第一句只是在描述羊的顏色，並不是本課教授的比喻意思。

rules.titleEn: Do not replace the target with a related form
rules.en: A common related form is the black sheep of the family. It is natural English, but every answer in this exercise must use the exact target a black sheep.
rules.zh: the black sheep of the family 是常見的相關形式，但本練習只訓練 a black sheep，因此每題答案都必須使用 a。

rules.en: It does not describe a person’s race or skin colour.
rules.zh: 直接把某人稱為 a black sheep 可能會傷害對方。 尤其當一個人沒有做錯事時，不應隨便以此稱呼對方。

rules.titleEn: Use careful wording in formal situations
rules.en: The employee is a black sheep.
rules.zh: 在正式報告中，通常應直接描述具體行為，而不是以帶有主觀判斷的慣用語標籤某人。

instructions.en: Preserve the original actor, event, tense, modality, degree of certainty and speaker attitude. The first word of each preferred answer has been provided.
instructions.zh: 使用確切目標慣用語 a black sheep 改寫句子或完成回應。
